desc: The Girls With Guns Assure Protective Safety Glasses & Earmuffs Combo Set features a matching set of safety glasses and earmuffs, great for shooting and overall general safety. Protective eyewear is metal framed, with soft nose pieces and ear pads for your temples, meeting ANSI Z87+ and CE ratings to help protect your eyes. Low-profile earmuffs have soft, foam lined ear cups, a padded headband, and have ANSI S3.19 and CE EN352-1 hearing protection ratings, delivering you a 23 db Noise Reduction Rating (NRR). No matter the challenge hunting, shooting, or working around loud machinery stay protected in style and you will be sure to turn heads your next outing.
